Knowledge recorded by Shinnecock elders in 2014

Geese

Geese supplied food and feathers, including fans used around fires and in clothing. Elders’ accounts of hunting at The Point emphasize care around nests and rules followed by outsiders hunting on Shinnecock land in the 1980s. The catalogue lists Canada geese, brant, and snow geese.1

Places named in the catalogue

Shinnecock territories; The Point; East End of Long Island.1

Page references

The Shinnecock Environmental Department compiled this catalogue from elders’ memories and community resource knowledge in 2014. Food and medicine appear here as historical knowledge; safe identification and treatment require current guidance.

Shinnecock Environmental Department, Natural Resources Identified by Shinnecock Elders, April 4, 2014, PDF pp. 12–13. Page numbers count the cover as PDF page 1.
